sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Jamie L. Stowers.
Jamie L. Stowers is listed as a records specialist in the latest available Transparent Utah records for fiscal year 2026.
She is married to AFPD Sergeant Adam R. Stowers.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Jamie L. Stowers's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2023 through 2026. The latest listed position is Records Specialist.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. Records through 2026 suggest continued employment, but do not confirm current status.
A Utah County deed from 2019 identifies Jamie and Adam Stowers as husband and wife. Adam's police employment is documented before then, while Jamie's records specialist entries begin in 2023.

Having spouses in the same department raises questions about who handled the hiring and whether either spouse has a say in the other's supervision, pay, discipline, or records involving their work. The relationship and timing are worth documenting, but they do not show that Jamie received preferential treatment.

sections.title: Records requests and body-camera redactions
descriptions: Reckless Ben’s May 30, 2026 video includes his recorded phone conversation with Jamie Stowers about audio redactions in police footage released for his case.

Schneider questions whether audio was removed to protect officers rather than victims. Stowers responds, “I don’t do that, Ben,” and says the redactions follow Utah State Code. The video presents Schneider’s interpretation of the redactions alongside the recorded exchange.
